Figure 3:Future Video Prediction across ID/OOD Scenes and Training Stages.We visualize predictions from the VGM trained in Fast-WAM[8]and PINT after Stage 1 and Stage 2 on the same ID and OOD inputs.
With the VGM frozen and no direct text conditioning, instruction semantics reach the VGM only through Predictive Intent, already yielding coarse task dynamics.
Stage 2 fixes the learned Intent and adapts the VGM for more accurate motion.

Figure 4:Predictive Intent visualization.We project ground-truth action chunks into a two-dimensional t-SNE space and color each point using a three-dimensional PCA projection of its corresponding Predictive Intent.
Representative behaviors from highlighted regions are shown.
Figure 5:Experimental overview.PINT is evaluated on LIBERO[50], LIBERO-Plus[14], RoboTwin 2.0[12], and five real-world bimanual tasks under ID/OOD settings.
